cards.ex: His plan to become a millionaire overnight seemed like a far-fetched idea to everyone.
cards.exUz: Uning bir kechada millioner bo'lish rejasi hamma uchun asoslanmagan fikrdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi qiyin yoki ishonishga arzimaydigan g'oya.

cards.ex: The meeting was all about blue-sky thinking – no idea was too crazy.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuv butunlay chegarasiz tafakkur haqida edi - hech qanday g'oya juda aqldan ozgan emasdi.
cards.uzDef: Amaliy cheklovlar haqida o'ylamasdan ijodiy fikrlash.

cards.ex: The company fosters an innovative spirit by encouraging employees to experiment.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xodimlarni tajriba o'tkazishga undash orqali innovatsion ruhni rivojlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalar va usullarni yaratishga bo'lgan qobiliyat va xohish.

cards.ex: Sometimes, I need to listen to music to tap into my creativity.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan, ijodga murojaat qilish uchun musiqa tinglashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zining ijodiy qobiliyatlaridan foydalanish.

cards.ex: The success of the project exceeded our wildest dreams.
cards.exUz: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyati bizning eng yorqin orzularimizdan ham oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta va eng tasavvuriy orzular.

cards.ex: The author paints a vivid picture of life in the 1920s.
cards.exUz: Muallif 1920-yillardagi hayotni yorqin tasvirlab beradi.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar bilan aniq va batafsil tasvirlash.

cards.ex: She has a fertile imagination and is always coming up with new stories.
cards.exUz: Uning serhosil xayoli bor va u doimo yangi hikoyalar o'ylab topadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p va qiziqarli g'oyalar yaratish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: He seemed to pull the solution out of thin air.
cards.exUz: U yechimni hech narsadan topgandek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday manba yoki dalilsiz.

cards.ex: Understanding the creative process can help you overcome writer's block.
cards.exUz: Ijodiy jarayonni tushunish yozuvchining to'xtab qolishiga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: G'oya yaratish, rivojlantirish va amalga oshirish bosqichlari.

cards.ex: He often indulges in flights of fancy when he's bored.
cards.exUz: U zerikkanida ko'pincha xayol parvozlariga beriladi.
cards.uzDef: Amaliy emas, balki juda hayoliy g'oyalar.

cards.ex: The spark of inspiration for the novel came from a childhood memory.
cards.exUz: Roman uchun ilhom uquni bolalik xotirasidan kelib chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'lgan ilhom yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: We need to think outside limits if we want to find a truly original solution.
cards.exUz: Agar biz haqiqatan ham original yechim topmoqchi bo'lsak, chegaradan tashqari o'ylashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilingan yoki odatiy cheklovlar haqida o'ylamasdan fikrlash.

cards.ex: The cake was so beautifully decorated; it was a work of art.
cards.exUz: Tort shunchalik chiroyli bezatilganki, u san'at asari edi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy va mohirona yaratilgan narsa.

cards.ex: The director is known for pushing the envelope with his experimental films.
cards.exUz: Rejissyor o'zining eksperimental filmlari bilan chegarani kengaytirishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud chegaralarni oshirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Bringing in someone from outside the company can provide a fresh perspective.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyadan tashqaridan biror kimni olib kelish yangi nuqtai nazarni ta'minlashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni yechishning yangi va innovatsion usuli.

cards.ex: Painting is a form of artistic expression for her.
cards.exUz: Rasm chizish uning uchun badiiy ifoda shaklidir.
cards.uzDef: San'at orqali o'z fikrlari va his-tuyg'ularini namoyon etish.

cards.ex: The building features an innovative design that maximizes natural light.
cards.exUz: Binoda tabiiy yorug'likni maksimal darajada oshiradigan innovatsion dizayn mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va zamonaviy dizayn.

cards.ex: She decorated the room with creative flair, making it look amazing.
cards.exUz: U xonani ijodiy iste'dod bilan bezatdi va uni ajoyib ko'rinishga keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Badiiy mahoratni namoyon qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Starting a new job is like having a blank canvas.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishni boshlash bo'sh tuvalga ega bo'lish bilan bir xil.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani boshlash uchun imkoniyat.

cards.ex: The CEO's bold vision transformed the company.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktorning jasoratli tasavvuri kompaniyani o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va ishonchli kelajakni tasavvur qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: I can see the scene perfectly in my mind's eye.
cards.exUz: Men sahnani xayolimda mukammal ko'ra olaman.
cards.uzDef: Xayolida ko'rish yoki tasavvur qilish.

cards.ex: Maybe the whole thing was just a figment of my mind.
cards.exUz: Ehtimol, hammasi faqat mening xayol mahsulim edi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatda mavjud bo'lmagan, faqat xayolda yaratilgan narsa.

cards.ex: Edison was an inventive genius who changed the world.
cards.exUz: Edison dunyoni o'zgartirgan ixtirochi dahosi edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va original narsalarni ixtiro qilish uchun ajoyib qobiliyat.

cards.ex: Good science fiction stories really stretch the imagination.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi ilmiy fantastika hikoyalari haqiqatan ham xayolni cho'zadi.
cards.uzDef: Xayolotni kuchaytirish, yangi narsalar haqida o'ylashga undash.

cards.ex: His groundbreaking idea revolutionized the industry.
cards.exUz: Uning inqilobiy g'oyasi sanoatni tubdan o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi g'oyalardan keskin farq qiladigan va ta'sirli g'oya.

cards.ex: Parents can nurture creativity by providing their children with art supplies.
cards.exUz: Ota-onalar farzandlariga san'at materiallari bilan ta'minlash orqali ijodni o'stirishlari mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy qobiliyatni rivojlantirish va qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: She had a creative spark and started writing a poem.
cards.exUz: Uning ijodiy uchquni bor edi va u she'r yozishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'lgan ijodiy g'oya yoki ilhom.

cards.ex: Sometimes, it's good to just let your mind wander.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan, shunchaki xayolga erkinlik berish yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarga cheklovsiz oqim berish, o'zingizni fikrlashga majburlamaslik.

cards.ex: They came up with some outlandish ideas for the project.
cards.exUz: Ular loyiha uchun ba'zi g'ayrioddiy g'oyalar bilan kelishdi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan juda farq qiladigan va g'alati tuyuladigan g'oyalar.

cards.ex: It takes bold imagination to create such a unique piece of art.
cards.exUz: Bunday noyob san'at asarini yaratish uchun jasur xayol kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsadan qo'rqmasdan katta va yangi g'oyalar o'ylab topish qobiliyati.
